source: Facade rhythm spec (FACADE_SPEC in hotel-de-l-europe-builder.ts), counted on panoramas rectified onto each facade line: SE b_20241211_0954_Track19_Sphere_00235 + boat TMX7316010203-000354_pano_0001_001522; SW TMX7316010203-002925_pano_0000_000128 + boat _000236; NW TMX7316010203-001609_pano_0000_000090/_000094. One facade entry per section, so the window-rhythm check compares like with like; ground storeys (conservatory ribbons, entrance) and roofs are cropped out.

facades.name: Amstel side (SE) section C
